description: A preset the server does not offer in the Accept of a request whose Content-Type is offered (base): the Accept lists no preset the server offers, 406 with RPP-Code 02004 (core 14.3).
comment: Skipped on epp-docker: the EPP config signals the profile by the RPP-Profile header; profile_signalling_header/ covers the header method.

steps.comment: Reads domain b3, with Content-Type application/rpp+json; profile="urn:ietf:params:rpp:profile:base"; profile-version="1.0", Accept application/rpp+json; profile="urn:ietf:params:rpp:profile:epp-compatibility"; profile-version="1.0"; expects 406 02004. An error answer this case checks. Only where the server offers no epp profile (rri-mtest).

Reads domain b3, with Content-Type application/rpp+json; profile="urn:ietf:params:rpp:profile:base"; profile-version="1.0", Accept application/rpp+json; profile="de.denic.rpp.profile.rri"; profile-version="1.0"; expects 406 02004. The error answer this case checks. Only where the server offers no rri profile (epp-docker).
